description: The scheduled DAILY snapshot job plus its gating properties. Once per capture period, for each enabled+computable cluster, compute the REAL current clusterMonthlyCost via the SAME authoritative engine (VerticalAutomationReadService.read -> VerticalEngineResponse.cost().clusterMonthlyCost()) and persist one ClusterCostSnapshot row via FEAT-001's repository. Skip (write NO row) when the snapshot switch is off, the cost feature is off, or cost is null/unavailable — never a fake 0. Enumeration + account resolution copy AutomaticApplyService (B4 legacy cloud_account_id ambiguity). Gated by a new ClusterCostSnapshotProperties master switch (default OFF, ON only in UAT) AND K8sCostProperties.enabled(). Depends on FEAT-001 (entity + repository).
steps: Create xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/automation/workload/cost/ClusterCostSnapshotProperties.java as a standalone @Component following AutoApplyProperties/K8sCostProperties: @Value(":default") constructor fields enabled (key xamops.k8s.cost.snapshot.enabled, default false), intervalMinutes (key ...snapshot.interval-minutes, default 1440 = daily), priorLookbackHours (key ...snapshot.prior-lookback-hours, default 24), priorToleranceHours (key ...snapshot.prior-tolerance-hours, default 12). Expose public accessors enabled(), intervalMinutes(), priorLookbackHours(), priorToleranceHours(). Add public static final String *_KEY constants. Follow K8sCostProperties precedent: NO KEYS parity test is required and the key need not be declared in all five profiles (inline defaults cover absent profiles).

In xamops-service/src/main/resources/application-uat.properties, declare xamops.k8s.cost.snapshot.enabled=true immediately after the existing xamops.k8s.cost.enabled=true line (~line 329), with a short comment that the snapshot loop is ON only in UAT. Do NOT add the key to the other four profiles (the inline false default keeps them off), matching how xamops.k8s.cost.enabled is declared only in uat.

Create xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/automation/workload/cost/ClusterCostSnapshotService.java as a @Service modeled on AutomaticApplyService. Constructor-inject: ClusterCostSnapshotProperties, K8sCostProperties, VerticalAutomationReadService, KubernetesClusterConfigRepository, CloudAccountRepository, ClusterCostSnapshotRepository, and a java.time.Clock (provide a public production constructor defaulting Clock.systemUTC() and a package-private constructor taking Clock, exactly as AutomaticApplyService does, for the test seam).

Add the scheduled entry point: @Scheduled(fixedDelayString = "#{${xamops.k8s.cost.snapshot.interval-minutes:1440} * 60 * 1000}", initialDelay = 60_000) public void runCycle(). First line: if (!snapshotProperties.enabled() || !costProperties.enabled()) return; (master gate inside the method, exactly like AutomaticApplyService.runCycle). Wrap the enumeration in try/catch so a failure enumerating clusters does not kill the scheduler thread.

Add @Transactional(readOnly = true) public void snapshotAllEnabledClusters(): iterate clusterConfigRepository.findAll(); for each config, in a per-cluster try/catch (one cluster's failure must not stop the others), resolve the CloudAccount by copying AutomaticApplyService.resolveAccount (findById first, then findByAwsAccountId for legacy rows); skip when no account/clientId; build a ClusterTarget(clientId, config.getId(), account.getAwsAccountId(), config.getClusterName(), config.getRegion()); call readService.read(account, target, config); if read.cost() == null || read.cost().clusterMonthlyCost() == null, log a structured skip (cluster named via target.describe(), NEVER the AWS account number) and continue WITHOUT writing a row; otherwise construct a ClusterCostSnapshot (clusterConfigId = config.getId(), clusterMonthlyCost = read.cost().clusterMonthlyCost(), capturedAt = clock.instant()) and save it via ClusterCostSnapshotRepository. Emit one structured summary log line at the end (scanned / snapshotted / skipped).
Ensure no log line ever includes the 12-digit AWS account number (use ClusterTarget.describe() or the config id), matching AutomaticApplyService's logging discipline.
acceptance_criteria: ClusterCostSnapshotProperties binds xamops.k8s.cost.snapshot.* with safe defaults (enabled=false, interval-minutes=1440, prior-lookback-hours=24, prior-tolerance-hours=12) and application-uat.properties declares xamops.k8s.cost.snapshot.enabled=true (and only uat does).
ClusterCostSnapshotService.runCycle() returns immediately unless both the snapshot switch and K8sCostProperties.enabled() are on.

For an enabled cluster whose read.cost().clusterMonthlyCost() is non-null, exactly one ClusterCostSnapshot row is written with that value and capturedAt from the injected Clock; when cost is null, NO row is written.
The job reuses VerticalAutomationReadService.read(...) (the authoritative automation cost path) and never recomputes cost or touches the agent-dashboard path.

findings: Properties: com.xammer.cloud.service.automation.workload.cost.ClusterCostSnapshotProperties (@Component). Single @Value-bound constructor (no multi-constructor seam needed): ClusterCostSnapshotProperties(boolean enabled, int intervalMinutes, int priorLookbackHours, int priorToleranceHours). Keys/defaults: ENABLED_KEY=xamops.k8s.cost.snapshot.enabled (false), INTERVAL_MINUTES_KEY=xamops.k8s.cost.snapshot.interval-minutes (1440), PRIOR_LOOKBACK_HOURS_KEY=xamops.k8s.cost.snapshot.prior-lookback-hours (24), PRIOR_TOLERANCE_HOURS_KEY=xamops.k8s.cost.snapshot.prior-tolerance-hours (12). Accessors: enabled(), intervalMinutes(), priorLookbackHours(), priorToleranceHours(). No KEYS parity test (K8sCostProperties precedent); enabled declared true ONLY in application-uat.properties (right after xamops.k8s.cost.enabled=true). Service: com.xammer.cloud.service.automation.workload.cost.ClusterCostSnapshotService (@Service). Constructors: public @Autowired ClusterCostSnapshotService(ClusterCostSnapshotProperties snapshotProperties, K8sCostProperties costProperties, VerticalAutomationReadService readService, KubernetesClusterConfigRepository clusterConfigRepository, CloudAccountRepository cloudAccountRepository, ClusterCostSnapshotRepository snapshotRepository) delegates to Clock.systemUTC(); package-private test seam ClusterCostSnapshotService(... same 6 deps ..., java.time.Clock clock). Scheduled entry: @Scheduled(fixedDelayString="#{${xamops.k8s.cost.snapshot.interval-minutes:1440} * 60 * 1000}", initialDelay=60_000) public void runCycle() — first line `if (!snapshotProperties.enabled() || !costProperties.enabled()) return;`, enumeration wrapped in try/catch. Body: @Transactional(readOnly=true) public void snapshotAllEnabledClusters() iterates clusterConfigRepository.findAll(), per-cluster try/catch, resolveAccount(findById then findByAwsAccountId(String.valueOf(cloudAccountId)).stream().findFirst()), skips no-account/no-client; builds ClusterTarget(clientId, config.getId(), account.getAwsAccountId(), config.getClusterName(), config.getRegion()); read = readService.read(account, target, config); if read.cost()==null || read.cost().clusterMonthlyCost()==null -> structured skip (target.describe(), NEVER account number), no row; else new ClusterCostSnapshot(clusterConfigId, read.cost().clusterMonthlyCost(), clock.instant()) saved via snapshotRepository.save(...). Summary log: 'scanned/snapshotted/skipped'. Private snapshotOne(KubernetesClusterConfig) returns boolean (true=written). For FEAT-003 test: inject fixtures via the package-private Clock constructor; mock VerticalAutomationReadService.read(...) to return a VerticalEngineResponse whose .cost() is a CostSummaryDto with clusterMonthlyCost set (write branch), null cost / null clusterMonthlyCost (skip branch), and toggle snapshotProperties.enabled()/costProperties.enabled() for the off branch. costProperties.enabled() gate uses K8sCostProperties.disabled()/enabledDefaults() helpers. The read path (not this service) still owns previousClusterMonthlyCost; this service only reads .cost().clusterMonthlyCost(). Verified: `mvn -q -o -pl . compile` OK.
